cross.take: Matches my B-P7: it measures a real and fast-growing customer, AI shoppers, with a revenue number, but agent-driven sales are still a small base.

picks.why: Still the biggest, most frequent real-money pain in the pool, with a mechanism proven to free 1-5% of GDP in liquidity a year.
Two agents independently reached the same pivot: a callback on every payment turns Fire Drill into a control that blocks today's BEC losses.
Containment with very few false alarms for the agent attack that cannot be prevented, needed by every company that connects agents to private data.
A daily, growing pain for every team merging agent PRs, with a clear per-PR metric.
Two agents converged on the defensive Two-Face; A's visibility engine makes it measurable and protects agents on every page today.
